The '''Icewall Ravine''' was a ice canyon that was located in [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The ravine linked the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] to the east and the [[Warlord's Deep]] to the south, and a [[Overrun machine vault|Rakatan vault]] was located in the canyon. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] overran the ravine and the vault.<ref name="TOR" /> After their [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Eternal Empire]] built a [[Belsavis shield bunker|shield bunker]] in the ravine to support the [[Belsavis Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] that was placed in geosynchronous orbit above the Tomb.<ref name="KOTFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Icewall Ravine appears as a subregion of the Tomb on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> The [[2015]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' added the [[Zakuul]] shield bunker to the canyon.<ref name="KOTFE" />
